name: Mubadala Investment Company
verdict: Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund; its own site says its sole shareholder is the government of Abu Dhabi.

why.text: Mubadala Investment Company is wholly owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi: its own site describes the government as its sole shareholder. In July 2024, a court in Abu Dhabi sentenced 43 people, including human rights defenders, to life in prison after a mass trial that human rights monitors called unfair. The fund's name and money behind Brazil's boat make the country look good to fans while that goes on. That's called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial.
